59000.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of sabba

examples.text: sīlabbataṃ vā'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, kammañ'ca sāvajj'anavajjam'etaṃ, suddhiṃ asuddhin'ti apatthayāno, virato care santim'anuggahāya.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, yathā ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hoti, api nu tvaṃ evarūpaṃ vohārasamucchedaṃ attani samanupassasī'ti?
yaṃ kiñci yiṭṭhaṃ va hutaṃ va loke, saṃvaccharaṃ yajetha puññapekkho, sabbam'pi taṃ na catubhāgam'eti, abhivādanā ujugatesu seyyo.

seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ samma'd'eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, evam'eva tesaṃ caturāsītipāṇasahassānaṃ tasmiṃ'y'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi, yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti

59002.meaning2: in all ways; from all angles

59003.meaning1: complete in every aspect; fulfilled in every way

examples.text: imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu samantapāsādiko ca hoti sabb'ākāraparipūro cā'ti.
heṭṭhā kho pana tassa bhoto gotamassa pādatalesu cakkāni jātāni sahass'ārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabb'ākāraparipūrāni, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

59004.meaning1: perfect in every aspect; excellent in all ways

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, udāyi, maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno sabb'ākārasampanno, tatr'idaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā.

59005.meaning1: endowed with all excellent attributes; having all the best qualities
59005.meaning2: endowed with all excellent attributes; having all the best qualities

examples.text: tadā'si yaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ, tadā'si lomahaṃsanaṃ, sabb'ākāra-var'ūpete, sambuddhe parinibbute'ti.

59006.meaning1: abandoned all unwholesome qualities; removed everything unskilful
59006.commentary: (MNa) sabb'ākusaladhammapahīno kho, mahārāja, tathāgato kusaladhammasamannāgato'ti ettha sabbesaṃ'y'eva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ vaṇṇetī'ti. āma vaṇṇetī'ti vutte yathā pucchā, tathā attho vutto bhaveyya. evaṃ byākaraṇaṃ pana na bhāriyaṃ. appahīnaakusalo'pi hi pahānaṃ vaṇṇeyya, bhagavā pana pahīn'ākusalatāya yathākārī tathāvādī'ti dassetuṃ evaṃ byākāsi. sukkapakkhe'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho, bhante ānanda, so bhagavā sabbesaṃ'y'eva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ vaṇṇetī'ti? sabb'ākusaladhammapahīno kho, mahārāja, tathāgato kusaladhammasamannāgato'ti.

59008.meaning2: Chapter 5 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paṭissutvā soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sabbān'eva sarena abhaṇi.
sabb'ābhibhū sabbavidū'ham'asmi, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalitto, sabbañ'jaho taṇhakkhaye vimutto, sayaṃ abhiññāya kam'uddiseyyaṃ.
sabb'ābhibhuṃ sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalittaṃ, sabbañ'jahaṃ taṇhākkhaye vimuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ naraṃ ekavihārī'ti brūmī'ti.
brahmabhūto atitulo, mārasenappamaddano, sabb'āmitte vasī katvā, modāmi akutobhayo.

59012.meaning1: all intentional undertaking; all karmic activity; all initiative

examples.text: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ ārambhapaccayā, sabb'ārambhaṃ paṭinissajja, anārambhe vimuttino.

59013.meaning1: all sense fields; all sense bases

59014.meaning1: adorned in all finery; dressed up in all jewellery

examples.text: sattame divase pāto'va uṭṭhāya gandh'odakena nhāyitvā cattāri satasahassāni vissajjetvā mahādānaṃ datvā sabb'ālaṅ'kāravibhūsitā varabhojanaṃ bhuñjitvā
mahānāgaṃ mahāvīraṃ, mahājutim'anāsavaṃ, sabb'āsavaparikkhīṇaṃ, satthāram'akutobhayaṃ.
āraddhavīriyo pahit'atto, iddhiyā pāramiṃ gato, sabb'āsave pariññāya, nibbāyissati'nāsavo.

59016.meaning1: method for the restraint of all the effluents; (comm) cause for the restraint of all the taints
59016.commentary: (MNa) sabb'āsavasaṃvarapariyāyan'ti sabbesaṃ āsavānaṃ saṃvarakāraṇaṃ saṃvarabhūtaṃ kāraṇaṃ, yena kāraṇena te saṃvaritā pidahitā hutvā anuppādanirodhasaṅkhātaṃ khayaṃ gacchanti pahīyanti nappavattanti, taṃ kāraṇan'ti attho.

examples.text: sabb'āsavasaṃvarapariyāyaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.

59017.meaning1: restrained with regard to all the effluents
59017.commentary: (MNa) sabb'āsavasaṃvarasaṃvuto'ti sabbehi āsavapidhānehi pihito, sabbesaṃ vā āsavānaṃ pidhānehi pihito.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabb'āsavasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati, acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mān'ābhisamayā antam'akāsi dukkhassā'ti.

59019.grammar: pron, fem gen pl of sabba

examples.text: atha kho aparā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, kassa nu kho, bhagavā, subhāsitan'ti? sabbāsaṃ vo subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena, api ca mama'pi suṇātha

59020.synonym: kasiṇa, kiṇha, kevala, kevalakappa, nissesa, sakala, sabbanta

examples.text: n'āssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti
iti uddham'adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabb'attatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharati.

59022.meaning1: all grasping; all clinging; all attachment

examples.text: sabb'upādānapariññāya dhammo, cakkhuñ'ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso.

59023.meaning1: wearing away of all grasping; ending of all clinging; extinction of every attachment

examples.text: evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, ajjhattaṃ vimokkhā khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, sabb'upādānakkhayā tathā sato viharāmi yathā sataṃ viharantaṃ āsavā n'ānussavanti, attānañ'ca n'āvajānāmī'ti. evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyan'ti.

59024.commentary: (MNa) na sammā sabbupādānapariññan'ti sabbesaṃ upādānānaṃ samatikkamaṃ sammā na paññapenti.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sabb'upādānapariññāvādā paṭijānamānā. te na sammā sabb'upādānapariññaṃ paññapenti, kām'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti, na diṭṭh'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti
sabb'upādānapariññāya dhammo cakkhuñ'ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso.

59025.meaningLit: discourse on the complete comprehension of all identification

59026.meaning1: asserting the complete comprehension of all identification
59026.commentary: (MNa) sabb'upādānapariññāvādā paṭijānamānā'ti mayaṃ sabbesaṃ upādānānaṃ pariññaṃ samatikkamaṃ vadāmā'ti evaṃ paṭijānamānā.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sabb'upādānapariññāvādā paṭijānamānā. te na sammā sabb'upādānapariññaṃ paññapenti, kām'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti, na diṭṭh'upādānassa pariññaṃ paññapenti

59027.meaning1: exhausting all acquisition; depleting of all attachment

examples.text: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimokkhā pariyādinnaṃ me upādānan'ti pajānāti. ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, sabb'upādāna-pariyādānāya dhammo'ti.

59028.meaning1: letting go all attachment; releasing all sense of ownership
59028.commentary: (MNa) yasmā ca taṃ āgamma sabbe upadhayo paṭinissaṭṭhā honti, sabbā taṇhā khīyanti, sabbe kilesarāgā virajjanti, sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nirujjhati, tasmā sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho'ti vuccati.

examples.text: tasmā evaṃ samannāgato bhikkhu iminā paramena cāg'ādhiṭṭhānena samannāgato hoti. eso hi, bhikkhu, paramo ariyo cāgo yadidaṃ, sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo.
etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānan'ti

59029.meaning1: to let go of all attachment; to release all my making
59029.meaningLit: for the sake of letting go…
59029.commentary: (ANa) sabb'ūpadhi-paṭinissagg'atthāya padhānan'ti sabbesaṃ khandh'ūpadhi-kiles'ūpadhi-abhisaṅkhār'ūpadhi-saṅkhātānaṃ upadhīnaṃ paṭinissaggasaṅkhātassa nibbānassa atthāya vipassanāya c'eva maggena ca sahajātavīriyaṃ.

examples.text: katamāni dve? yañ'ca gihīnaṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasataṃ cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānapaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhār'ānuppadān'atthaṃ padhānaṃ, yañ'ca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissagg'atthaṃ padhānaṃ. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve padhānāni durabhisambhavāni lokasmiṃ.

59030.meaning1: extinction of all attachment; destruction of all identification

examples.text: yassa jālinī visattikā, taṇhā n'atthi kuhiñci netave, sabb'ūpadhiparikkhayā buddho, soppati kiṃ tav'ettha mārā'ti.

59031.meaning1: letting go all attachment; releasing all sense of ownership

examples.text: katamā c'ānanda, virāgasaññā? idh'ānanda, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhippaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nibbānan'ti.

59032.grammar: pron, masc nom pl of sabba

examples.text: sabbe tasanti daṇḍassa, sabbesaṃ jīvitaṃ piyaṃ, attānaṃ upamaṃ katvā, na haneyya na ghātaye.
sabbe saddhammagaruno, vihariṃsu viharanti ca, athā'pi viharissanti, esā buddhāna dhammatā.
ye hi keci, rāhula, atītam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyakammaṃ parisodhesuṃ… sabbe te evam'evaṃ paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā kāyakammaṃ parisodhesuṃ
evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati.

seyyathā'pi, āvuso, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati yadidaṃ mahantattena, evam'eva kho, āvuso, ye keci kusalā dhammā sabb'ete catūsu ariyasaccesu saṅgahaṃ gacchanti.

ye'me, bho gotama, samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇ'ācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā, bahujanassa… sabb'ete sakāya paṭiññāya abbhaññaṃsu sabb'eva n'ābbhaññaṃsu, udāhu ekacce abbhaññaṃsu ekacce n'ābbhaññaṃsū'ti?
ye kho pana me, pañcasikha, sāvakā sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājānanti, te āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, yathā ariyassa vinaye sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ vohārasamucchedo hoti, api nu tvaṃ evarūpaṃ vohārasamucchedaṃ attani samanupassasī'ti?

59036.meaning1: everywhere in every way; completely and totally
59036.commentary: (MNa) sabbena sabban'ti sabb'ākārena sabbaṃ. sabbathā sabban'ti sabbakoṭṭhāsehi sabbaṃ. (NIDD1a) sabbena sabban'ti sabbenākārena sabbaṃ. sabbathā sabban'ti sabbappakārena sabbaṃ.

examples.text: yo c'āvuso hetu yo ca paccayo cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādāya so ca hetu so ca paccayo sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ aparisesā nirujjheyya, api nū kho cakkhuviññāṇaṃ paññāyethā'ti?

59037.meaning1: in each and every way; completely and utterly

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca, atthi nu kho, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhu'pi tehi dhammehi sabbenasabbaṃ sabbathāsabbaṃ samannāgato yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhavaṃ gotamo ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho'ti?

59038.meaning1: it would (be for the benefit) of all

examples.text: sabbe ce'pi, bhante, khattiyā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ, sabbesam'pi'ssa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.

59039.grammar: pron, masc & nt dat pl of sabba

examples.text: tañ'ca pana na sabbesaṃ, jinaputtānaṃ y'eva ārabbha bhaṇitaṃ, abyāvaṭā tumhe, ānanda, hotha tathāgatassa sarīrapūjāyā'ti.

59040.grammar: pron, masc & nt gen pl of sabba

examples.text: kassa nu kho, bhante, subhāsitan'ti? sabbesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena, api ca yaṃ mayā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ pārāyane metteyyapañhe

so suṇāti tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā sabbesaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhāna-adhiṭṭhāna-pariyuṭṭhāna-abhinivesa-anusayānaṃ samugghātāya sabbasaṅkhārasamathāya sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggāya taṇhākkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammaṃ desentassa.

59041.meaning1: all just; one and all; everyone; everything

examples.text: sabb'eva tuṇhībhūtā pañjalikā pallaṅkena nisīdanti, yassa'dāni devassa pallaṅkaṃ icchissati brahmā sanaṅkumāro, tassa devassa pallaṅke nisīdissatī'ti.
kenassu nīyati loko, kenassu parikassati, kissa'ssu ekadhammassa, sabb'eva vasam'anvagū'ti.
sabbehi dhātūhi yamhi paccaye pare ivaṇṇ'āgamo hoti vā. karīyate, karīyati, gacchīyate, gacchīyati. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? kayyate.
sabbehi dhātūhi yapaccayo pubbarūpam'āpajjate vā. vuḍḍhate, phallate, dammate, sakkate, labbhate, dissate.

59043.meaning1: by all just; with all indeed

examples.text: evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, vūpasametabbaṃ. sabbeh'eva ekajjhaṃ sannipatitabbaṃ, sannipatitvā byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo.
ettakaṃ tassa bhagavato sutt'āgataṃ suttapariyāpannaṃ anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati, sabbeh'eva samaggehi sammodamānehi avivadamānehi sikkhitabban'ti.

59044.commentary: (DNa) sabb'otukan'ti pupphaṃ nāma ekasmiṃ'y'eva utumhi pupphati. ahaṃ pana tathā karissāmi, yathā sabbesu utūsu pupphissatī'ti cintesiṃ.

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imāsu pokkharaṇīsu evarūpaṃ mālaṃ ropāpeyyaṃ uppalaṃ padumaṃ kumudaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ sabb'otukaṃ sabbajanassa anāvaṭan'ti.

59045.meaning1: this entire; the whole of this

examples.text: aññataro naṭapubbako bhikkhu evam'āha, sabbo'yaṃ maññe saṅgho sītīkato'ti.

59049.meaning1: with the wise; by the virtuous
59049.construction:
sa + nta + ebhi
santa + ebhi > sabbhi

examples.text: jīranti ve rājarathā sucittā, atho sarīram'pi jaraṃ upeti, satañ'ca dhammo na jaraṃ upeti, santo have sabbhi pavedayanti.
sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, sattā gacchanti suggatin'ti.

59050.meaning1: only with the wise; just with the virtuous

examples.text: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo'ti.
so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ
ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti

59053.construction:
sa + vya > bya + tā
sabya + tā

examples.text: te vata, vāseṭṭha, tevijjā brāhmaṇā yaṃ na jānanti, yaṃ na passanti, tassa sahabyatāya maggaṃ desessanti. ayam'eva ujumaggo ayam'añjas'āyano niyyāniko niyyāti takkarassa brahmasabyatāyā'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

59054.construction:
sa + vi + ā > byā + √pad > pād + *a + ya
sabyāpāda + ya

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīl'ānussatiṃ bhāveti.

59055.meaning1: full of ill-will; full of hatred
59055.meaning2: full of ill-will; full of hatred
59055.construction:
sa + vi + ā > byā + √pad > pād + *a + ya
sabyāpāda + ya

examples.text: sabyāpajjacittā vā abyāpajjacittā vā'ti? sabyāpajjacittā, bho gotama.

59056.meaning1: with a mind full of ill-will; with a heart full of hatred
59056.meaning2: with a mind full ill-will; with a heart full of hatred

examples.text: sabyāpajjacitto vā abyāpajjacitto vā'ti? abyāpajjacitto, bho gotama.

59057.construction:
sa + vi + ā > byā + √bādh + a + ya
sabyābādha + ya > sabyāpajjha

examples.text: katamañ'ca, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ? idha, puṇṇa, ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyāpajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.

59058.construction:
sa + vi + ā > byā + √bādh + a + ya
sabyābādha + ya > sabyābajjha

examples.text: katamañ'ca, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ? idha, puṇṇa, ekacco sabyābajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.

59060.meaning1: business partner; business associate; trading partner
59060.construction: sa + vi > vy > by + ava + √har > hār + *a

examples.text: sabrahmakāni, bhikkhave, tāni kulāni yesaṃ puttānaṃ mātāpitaro ajjhāgāre pūjitā honti.
so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.

59065.commentary: (UDa) sabrahmacārino'ti seṭṭh'aṭṭhena brahmasaṅkhātaṃ bhagavato sāsanaṃ ariyamaggaṃ saha caranti paṭipajjantī'ti sabrahmacārino.

examples.text: evam'etaṃ, āvuso ānanda, hoti yesaṃ āyasmantānaṃ tādisā sabrahmacārayo anukampakā atthakāmā ovādakā anusāsakā. idañ'ca pana me āyasmato ānandassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā dhammo abhisamito'ti.

59066.meaning1: liking one's spiritual companions; fond of one's fellow monastics
59066.commentary: (SNa) sabrahmacārikāmo'ti ime maṃ parivāretvā carantū'ti evaṃ kāmeti icchati patthetī'ti sabrahmacārikāmo.

examples.text: tatra yo hoti bhikkhu ñāto yasassī lābhī cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ taṃ therā bhikkhū āsanena nimantenti, ehi, bhikkhu, ko nām'āyaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddako vat'āyaṃ bhikkhu, sabrahmacārikāmo vat'āyaṃ bhikkhu, ehi, bhikkhu, idaṃ āsanaṃ nisīdāhī'ti.

59067.commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhāniyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ, yatth'assa tibbaṃ hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti pemañ'ca gāravo ca.
cudito vacībhi satim'ābhinande, sabrahmacārīsu khilaṃ pabhinde, vācaṃ pamuñce kusalaṃ n'ātivelaṃ, janavādadhammāya na cetayeyya.
asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa n'ābhijānāmi sabrahmacārīgattaparikamme vicāritā
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho

59071.meaning1: together with the goods; with the loot

59072.meaning1: provided with food; with (the expectation of ) a meal

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.

59073.meaning1: provided with food; with (the expectation of ) a meal

59074.synonym: akkhema, bhaya, visama, saītika, saparissaya, sappaṭibhaya

examples.text: sabhayo c'eso maggo sappaṭibhayo ca sakaṇṭako ca sagahano ca ummaggo ca kummaggo ca duhitiko ca. asappurisasevito c'eso maggo, na c'eso maggo sappurisehi sevito.

59075.meaning1: together with one's wife; accompanied by one's wives
59075.construction:
sa + √bhar + iya + ā + a
sabhariyā + a

examples.text: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ kosinārake malle kulaparivattaso kulaparivattaso ṭhapetvā bhagavantaṃ vandāpeyyaṃ, itthan'nāmo, bhante, mallo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī'ti.
niddāsīlī sabhāsīlī, anuṭṭhātā ca yo naro, alaso kodhapaññāṇo, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

sakko'pi kho, bhikkhave, devānam'indo deve tāvatiṃse āmantesi, sace, mārisā, dev'āsurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe devā jineyyuṃ asurā parājineyyuṃ, yena naṃ vepacittiṃ asur'indaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha sudhammaṃ devasabhan'ti.
sārambhaṃ nāma… pān'āgāranissitaṃ vā hoti, sūnanissitaṃ vā hoti, racchānissitaṃ vā hoti, caccaranissitaṃ vā hoti, sabhānissitaṃ vā hoti, saṃsaraṇanissitaṃ vā hoti. etaṃ sārambhaṃ nāma.

kathañ'ca, gahapatayo, catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti? idha, gahapatayo, ekacco musāvādī hoti. sabhāgato vā parisāgato vā, ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā, abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho, eh'ambho purisa, yaṃ jānāsi taṃ vadehī'ti

59079.meaning2: common, being of the same division
59079.commentary: (VINt) sabhāg'āpattiyo ca na vijjantī'ti ettha yaṃ sabbo saṅgho vikālabhojan'ādinā sabhāgavatthunā lahuk'āpattiṃ āpajjati, evarūpā vatthusabhāgā'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: uposatho, yāvatikā ca bhikkhū, kammappattā, sabhāga-āpattiyo ca, na vijjanti, vajjanīyā ca, puggalā tasmiṃ na honti, pattakallan'ti vuccati.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: tesañ'ca vikālabhojan'ādi-vasena vatthusabhāgaāpattiyo ce na vijjanti.

59082.meaning1: appearing in court; called to a council

examples.text: kathañ'ca, gahapatayo, catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti? idha, gahapatayo, ekacco musāvādī hoti. sabhāgato vā parisāgato vā, ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā, abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho, eh'ambho purisa, yaṃ jānāsi taṃ vadehī'ti

59084.commentary: (PYt) sabhāgajīvikā'ti iminā sabhāgavuttikā'ti ettha vuttisaddo jīvik'attho'y'eva, na vivaraṇ'ādy'attho'ti dasseti.

examples.text: so vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso sabhāgavuttiko sabrahmacārīsu ābhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatī'ti ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati. ābhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ paripūretvā sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatī'ti ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.
ime hi nāma, bhikkhave, gihī odātavatthavasanakā abhijīvanikassa sippassa kāraṇā ācariyesu sagāravā sappatissā sabhāgavuttikā viharissanti.

59086.meaning1: (vinaya) with the same offence; having an offence in common
59086.commentary: (KVa) sabhāg'āpattiyo ca na vijjantī'ti ettha yaṃ sabbo saṅgho vikālabhojan'ādinā sabhāgavatthunā lahuk'āpattiṃ āpajjati, evarūpā vatthusabhāgā sabhāgā'ti vuccati, vikālabhojanapaccayā āpannaṃ pana āpattisabhāgaṃ anatirittabhojanapaccayā āpannassa santike desetuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: sabhāg'āpattiyo ca na vijjanti kiṃ? vikālabhojanādivatthu sabhāg'āpattiyo ca na vijjanti.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: uposatho, yāvatikā ca bhikkhū kammappattā, sabhāg'āpattiyo ca na vijjanti, vajjanīyā ca puggalā tasmiṃ na honti pattakallan'ti vuccati.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

59087.meaning1: has the same feeling; shares the same idea
59087.commentary: (DNa) sabhāgāyissantī'ti yathā ahaṃ jīvāmi diṭṭhā bho sattā, tvam'pi tathā jīvasī'ti evaṃ sammodanakathāya attanā sabhāge karissanti.

examples.text: te tassa satt'āhassa accayena tiṇagahanā vanagahanā rukkhagahanā nadīviduggā pabbatavisamā nikkhamitvā aññam'aññaṃ āliṅgitvā sabhāgāyissanti samassāsissanti, diṭṭhā, bho, sattā jīvasi, diṭṭhā, bho, sattā jīvasīti.

59088.meaning1: council rules; protocols of the assembly
59088.commentary: (SNa) sabhādhamman'ti sukhanisinne kira asañcāletvā ekapassena pavisanaṃ tesaṃ sabhādhammo nāma, na mahājanaṃ cāletvā ujukam'eva pavisanaṃ. bhagavā ca ujukam'eva āgacchati, tena te kupitā bhagavantaṃ hīḷentā, ke ca muṇḍakā samaṇakā, ke ca sabhādhammaṃ jānissantī'ti āhaṃsu.

examples.text: addasaṃsu khomadussakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ. disvāna etadavocuṃ, ke ca muṇḍakā samaṇakā, ke ca sabhādhammaṃ jānissantī'ti?

59089.meaning1: situated near an assembly hall; located near to a meeting hall

examples.text: sārambhaṃ nāma… pān'āgāranissitaṃ vā hoti, sūnanissitaṃ vā hoti, racchānissitaṃ vā hoti, caccaranissitaṃ vā hoti, sabhānissitaṃ vā hoti, saṃsaraṇanissitaṃ vā hoti. etaṃ sārambhaṃ nāma.
sabhāye cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā sabhāye vā vatthabbaṃ dvāramūle vā, hatthapāsā vā na vijahitabbaṃ.

59091.meaning1: entered the assembly hall; seated in the council hall

examples.text: nāgo'va sannāni guṇāni chetvā, deve tāvatiṃse atikkamiṃsu, saindā devā sapajāpatikā, sabbe sudhammāya sabhāy'upaviṭṭhā.

59092.meaning1: gregarious; fond of company; of social nature

examples.text: niddāsīlī sabhāsīlī, anuṭṭhātā ca yo naro, alaso kodhapaññāṇo, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
ayaṃ pupphapūjā buddha-paccekabuddha-aggasāvaka-mahāsāvaka-arahant'ādīnaṃ sabhāva-sīlaṃ. aham'pi tesaṃ anuvattako homi.
yathā hi cakkhuviññāṇaṃ rūpe rūpamattam'eva passati, na anicc'ādisabhāvaṃ, evam'eva sesaṃ.
